pages.text: $(thing)Desert Locust$() ($(o)Schistocerca gregaria$()), insect.$(br2)$(li)$(thing)Hosts:$() all crops.$(li)$(thing)Spreads:$() migration.$(li)$(thing)Favoured by$() 25-38 °C (best 32 °C).
$(li)$(thing)Survives$() 0 years (migration).$(li)$(thing)Damage:$() up to 100% yield, can kill the plant.$(li)$(thing)Control:$() Regional early warning; Targeted biopesticide (Metarhizium).
